facts.text: Under the Access2Excellence initiative, Northern Arizona University provides full tuition coverage for new first-time undergraduate students with a family income of $65,000 a year or less.

sources.title: NAU expands Access2Excellence program to members of Arizona's federally recognized tribes - The NAU Review

facts.text: Northern Arizona University provides full tuition coverage for members of Arizona's 22 federally recognized tribes through an expansion to the Access2Excellence initiative.
